evidence.quote: Increasing the effectiveness of supervision must be a top priority for our institution.

Looking forward, I believe a more macroprudential approach to supervision--one that supplements the supervision of individual institutions to address risks to the financial system as a whole--could help to enhance overall financial stability.
As the past two years have brought home to everyone, the development of a more stable and sound financial system should be of the highest priority.
